notes: Hostile source-only fidelity audit against the Engrossed-in-House (EH) text (entire 5,706-char source read). No material fidelity errors: the core penalty framework verifies verbatim — illegal-entry max 2->5 years (INA 275(a)); new 5-year-to-life mandatory minimum for entry + a subsequent crime punishable by >1yr (INA 275(e)); reentry base up to 10 years (INA 276(a)); up to 15 years for 3+ drug/violent misdemeanors (INA 276(b)(1)(A)); 10-year-to-life mandatory minimum for aggravated-felony/felony/>1yr priors (INA 276(c)); Attorney General -> Secretary of Homeland Security authority shift. Flags are all minor: (1) one top-line overgeneralization dropping the 'drug/violent' qualifier on the 15-year misdemeanor tier (the section detail states it correctly); (2) one breadth-of-support framing note in likelihoodReason ('unified Democratic opposition'); and (3) five coverage omissions of narrower INA 276(b) penalty tiers/definitions and a conforming cross-reference change. OUT OF SCOPE / not adjudicated: featured_quotes (6 Congressional Record floor statements) are absent from the bill text and no CR referencedSource is registered, so they cannot be verified against the available source; versionChanges (Introduced->Engrossed diff) requires the Introduced-in-House text, which is not a registered referencedSource. Sponsor/cosponsor/vote figures in likelihoodReason are cache metadata, not in bill text.
